summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and refactored the three ignite handlers to delegate to them. Updated the in-repo callers (output_path to output_dir) and the classification test, and added the five specified test files. Nothing was run, since tests and repository code were off-limits; all verification was by reading. Lint (120-column limit, file endings, unused imports) was checked by reading only. No commits were made. Not done: docs/ were not updated, and ignite 0.3.0 attach behaviour and the NIfTI dtype assertions are unconfirmed until tests run.
